text: Memsy's vector search started timing out on every export over 10k records this week, and support hasn't replied to my ticket in 2 days.
We got double-charged on our July invoice — the annual plan fee AND the monthly fee both hit our card.
Would love a way to set custom TTLs per memory namespace instead of one global expiry setting.
The new dashboard redesign is confusing — I can't find where to view API usage anymore, it used to be one click from the home screen.
The quickstart docs reference an SDK method (memsy.recall_v1) that no longer exists in the current package version.
Our webhook integration with Memsy stopped firing after the last API version bump — no error, events just silently stop arriving.
I got locked out of our workspace after an SSO provider change and support couldn't restore access for 6 hours. That's unacceptable for a paid plan.
Support responded to my critical outage ticket in under 10 minutes and fixed it live on the call. Genuinely impressed.
Mobile app crashes every time I try to sync memories while offline mode is on.
Really solid experience overall, the CLI tools especially make local dev testing painless.
